_about: regression target r4_port1/runs/v5p/hot: monolith + padjoin 4 + gatevia (no chk) + gndtie + pinesc walled with twins (= refs U401,U501)

pinesc._why: board data: pinesc on both PD chips (r4_port1 v5p measured U401+U501 with gndtie: blocked 5, CC1/I2CC_SCL route; r5_merge m2 with U501 only: 13/15 failed vs m1 9/14/13 on the PC). The walled predicate picks only U501 on this placement (U401's pins are walled by routed neighbours, not by planned copper), and the twins test (tools/twin_probe2.py) finds 4 of 5 cluster neighbours matching on this placement (west LDO cap not copied) against 1 of 5 on the best placement, so no strict board-independent property separates them yet.

bus_layer._why: Protected copy of the high-current bus on a layer the router never routes; net/from/layer are derived (auto). The copy box is the only tuned board value: strapfix (round 3) picked it on routed loss. Derived box (auto) on the best placement: same screen (5 of 369, 0.834 W) but routed loss 1.201 W against 1.127 W with this box (r4_general/NOTES.md).
soft fill of the return net on the outer layer away from the hot loops (gives GND back the In4 area)
